finding_text: Fix plugins/mindspec/workflows/ms-panel.js:39-44 buildCommand and :66-68 dispatch, and the matching .claude/workflows/ms-panel.js copy, at a3fe87a3: `command += " --slot " + quote(value.slot) + " --dispatch";` never adds --replace, and `if (checkout.exit !== 0) return;` silently abandons the required redispatch. When a prior final exists and its replacement failed, use an explicitly authorized replacement retry with --replace (for both applicable launch/dispatch paths), retaining the bounded retry count. Replace the test expectation in plugins/mindspec/workflow_fixture_test.go workflowRefusedFinalReplacement that currently demands `exactly one attempt without --replace` with an end-to-end regression proving that a failed replacement can actually start the permitted new attempt. This is required by spec.md § Requirements > R12 — Skill and workflow slimming: "checkout for a dispatch takes --slot S --dispatch and, after a final, --replace" (inline-code delimiters omitted in this prose quotation; exact source span is quoted in the finding).
